needed.evidence: Footway is less than 1m wide and partly blocked with obstructions
needed.suggestion: Install a dedicated, continuous sidewalk of at least 1m width along the left side of the road.
Ensure the left footway is clear and free from parked vehicles by enforcing parking regulations or designating a vehicle-free walking path.

needed.evidence: Uneven surfaces contributing to major trip hazards
needed.suggestion: Repave and level the uneven sections of the left footway to create a safe walking surface.

needed.evidence: Marked zebra crossing without proper traffic calming or refuge
needed.suggestion: Introduce a refuge island or speed-reducing measures at the crossing to enhance safety for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Crossing is marked but hard for drivers to see and not signalized
needed.suggestion: Improve the visibility of the crossing by enhancing markings and adding traffic signals or warning signs to ensure drivers stop for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: No dropped kerbs at the marked zebra crossing
needed.suggestion: Install dropped kerbs at the crossing to facilitate wheelchair and pram access and provide a seamless transition for all pedestrians.
